roster_grade.headline: Loaded contender with an aging RB core and a QB room that needs to be monetized
roster_grade.window_explanation: Prime-age WR/TE core (Smith, Higgins, Loveland) keeps the window open 3-4 years, but Derrick Henry at 32 and Javonte Williams declining means your RB depth degrades fast without action.

strengths.label: Elite TE anchor
strengths.detail: Colston Loveland (22, KTC 6206) is a top-3 dynasty TE — young, locked in, and a decade of value ahead.

strengths.label: WR depth and youth
strengths.detail: 8 receivers averaging 3,620 KTC with Tory Horton (23), Jack Bech (23), and Kayshon Boutte (24) as upside depth behind Smith and Higgins.

strengths.label: Superflex QB surplus
strengths.detail: Mahomes + Bo Nix is a starting pair most teams dream of. Tyler Shough is a tradeable QB3 with real value.

strengths.label: Pick capital
strengths.detail: Holds a 2028 1st from TheMachoKing (league's weakest tier — likely an early pick) plus a 2027 2nd from Pitts-and-Swallows on top of all own future picks.

weaknesses.label: RB aging cliff incoming
weaknesses.detail: Derrick Henry (32, Declining) and Javonte Williams (26, Declining) are both flagged. You're one bad season from a position collapse if Alvin Kamara and Chuba Hubbard can't hold.

weaknesses.label: Power rank gap
weaknesses.detail: You're #7 by KTC in a league where 6 teams outvalue you — Rolling Ball (95k), Pitts-and-Swallows (89k), You Hate Us (88k) are all ahead. You need to convert surplus into a tier jump.

weaknesses.label: No elite young RB
weaknesses.detail: RJ Harvey (25) is the youngest proven back; rookies Claiborne (22) and Randall (21) inject youth but are unproven. No established Rising-window RB yet — an in-season buy-low is the fix.

roster_grade.most_urgent_action: TE logjam resolved — Sadiq flipped to Macho King for his 2028 1st (likely a top-5 pick; league's #11 team). New target: RB is now 9-deep with aging vets (Henry 32, Javonte, Hubbard, Kamara all Declining). That's surplus, not depth. Sell a declining vet (Javonte 3014 is your most valuable sell) into a contender for a young WR or pick before their value erodes further. Also still sitting on a QB3 (Shough) to monetize.

QB.commentary: Mahomes + Bo Nix is the top SF pair in the league. Shough is the sellable QB3 — 3 QBs is the right carry, so move him only for real value.

RB.commentary: Volume is there but the vets are aging out: Henry (32), Javonte (Declining), Kamara (30), Hubbard (Declining). RJ Harvey plus rookies Claiborne and Randall are the future of the room.

WR.commentary: Smith, Higgins, Watson, and Washington form a deep core. Horton, Bech, and Boutte add real upside off the bench.

TE.commentary: Loveland is the best young TE in the league. Hockenson adds proven vet depth. Gunnar Helm on taxi is a bonus stash.

trade_priority_order: Sell Tyler Shough for a young Rising-window RB or WR under 24
Sell Derrick Henry (32, Declining) while he still has perceived value after a strong 2025
Buy Brian Thomas Jr., Marvin Harrison Jr., or C.J. Stroud from rebuilding teams
Sell Javonte Williams if the right offer comes — Declining at 26 is a red flag
Package Christian Watson + a 2027 pick for a young RB upgrade

sell_now.reason: You have 3 QBs in a 2-QB SF league and Mahomes/Nix are locked in. Shough (26, FC ~3270) has starter upside but you don't need him — his value won't get higher than right now before he plays meaningful snaps.
sell_now.ask: Young RB or WR under 25 with Rising window, or a 2027 1st

sell_now.reason: 32 years old, Declining window. He's still producing which is exactly why you move him now — peak sell is always before the decline is obvious.
sell_now.ask: 2026 or 2027 2nd + a young piece, or straight swap for a Rising RB

sell_now.reason: Declining at 26 is a worrying sign — he's past his peak. Move him while he's still a recognizable name.
sell_now.ask: Young WR or RB with Rising window

buy_now.reason: Young, Rising-window WR — recently traded to Phil’s Dong Dusters. Still a buy-low target; lead with Shough if they need QB. (Confirm their needs in the live Trade Finder.)
Rebuilding team, Rising QB at high value — they may want picks or an established piece instead.
Win-Now team that might part with a young WR for proven veteran production. Offer Henry + a pick.

do_not_trade: Patrick Mahomes — keeps your SF ceiling elite; only move him if the offer is historically overpaying
Colston Loveland — top-3 dynasty TE at 22, untouchable
Bo Nix — keep as your SF2 behind Mahomes for now; sell Shough instead
DeVonta Smith — prime age WR1, hold through 2026
Tee Higgins — same window as Smith, core piece
trade_strategy.pick_strategy: Draft complete. Hold the acquired 2028 1st (Macho King — likely early) and your own future 1sts; 2nd-4th rounders are packaging material in a deal for a proven young RB or WR.

pick_strategy.portfolio_summary: DRAFT COMPLETE. Used all 4 picks at slot 9 (linear): 1.09 Kenyon Sadiq (TE), 2.09 De'Zhaun Stribling (WR), 3.09 Demond Claiborne (RB), 4.09 Adam Randall (RB).
pick_strategy.draft_day_strategy: Solid value draft — took best-available at each slot. The two rookie RBs (Claiborne 22, Randall 21) meaningfully refresh an aging backfield, which was the #1 goal. The Sadiq pick at 1.09 was correct on value (Price gone at pick 4, Concepcion/Cooper gone by 8) but creates a TE surplus to resolve via trade.

top_pick_at_109.name: Kenyon Sadiq (taken)
top_pick_at_109.reason: Best-available by FC at pick 9 after the board got picked clean ahead of you. Good value, redundant fit — flip Hockenson or Sadiq to monetize the surplus.

picks_ok_to_package: Future 2nd-4th rounders in a deal for a proven young RB

outlook.projected_power_rank: #7 by KTC — but don't let that discourage you. This is a Contending roster that plays above its KTC ranking due to SF QB strength.
outlook.three_year_outlook: Strong 2026-2027 contention window before the RB core ages out. 2028 depends on the rookie RBs (Claiborne, Randall) hitting, the Macho 2028 1st, and whether Bo Nix sustains.
outlook.season_narrative: The Jabroni Beaters open the season as a legitimate contender. Mahomes + Bo Nix is superflex-elite, the WR room (Smith, Higgins, Watson) is deep, and Loveland is a top-3 dynasty TE. The one soft spot is an aging RB room (Henry, Javonte, Hubbard, Kamara) — rookies Claiborne and Randall plus the banked 2028 1st are the long-term answer. Win now while the QB/WR core is in its prime, and convert Shough and a declining RB into help as the weeks reveal real needs.
key_risks: Derrick Henry (32) regression — he's been historic but age is real
Javonte Williams decline accelerates — losing both RB1s in one year is dangerous
Bo Nix plateaus at a game-manager level — your SF advantage depends on him being a real QB2
Staying passive — the QB surplus is perishable capital. If you don't sell, it decays.
key_upside_factors: Tyler Shough emerges as a QB1 — sells for huge value
A rookie RB (Claiborne or Randall) carves out a role and stabilizes the backfield
Tory Horton / Jack Bech breakout — you have two 23-year-old WRs with legit upside sitting on your bench
Colston Loveland becomes the undisputed best TE in dynasty — his ceiling hasn't been priced in yet

teams_to_watch.why: The KTC leader at 95k — they're the team to beat and are Win-Now. Target them when they overpay for veterans.
Lowest KTC in the league (37k) and Rebuilding — they should be selling everyone. Great trade partner for your QB surplus.
Rebuilding with C.J. Stroud and Bryce Young — they might move Stroud for the right offer. Monitor closely.

add_immediately.name: Trey Benson
add_immediately.reason: 23yo RB, Prime window, FC 758 — best FA on the board. Real NFL path to touches in Arizona. Proven young back > deep-stash dart, and still reinforces your aging RB room even after the draft.

add_if_can.name: Xavier Hutchinson
add_if_can.reason: Texans WR, 26, highest raw value on the wire (~1615) — WR insurance behind your Smith/Higgins core. Valuation is KTC-only so trust it a bit less.

add_if_can.name: Elic Ayomanor
add_if_can.reason: 23yo Rising-window WR (FC 704) — highest-ceiling young swing available. Stash for upside.

add_if_can.name: Chimere Dike
add_if_can.reason: 24yo Prime WR (FC 715) — depth piece with a real role.

deep_stash.name: Marvin Mims
deep_stash.reason: 24yo Broncos WR (FC 406) — explosive, ascending role. Cheap upside hold.

deep_stash.name: Tez Johnson
deep_stash.reason: 24yo Prime WR (FC 398) — late-round flier with a path.

deep_stash.name: Bryce Lance
deep_stash.reason: Developmental stash (FC 814) if you want to gamble on the name/pedigree.

fa_targets.waiver_strategy: Add Trey Benson first — he's the most valuable and best-fitting FA available. After that you're in stash territory; prioritize young WRs (Ayomanor, Dike) over the aging vets. SKIP all TEs (Dulcich, Engram) — you have a 3-TE logjam (Loveland/Hockenson/Sadiq) to trade DOWN from, not add to. Don't add any QB — you have 4.

4046.sell_reasoning: Don't. Mahomes is your superflex ceiling — the Mahomes/Nix pair is why you contend. At 30 he has 4-5 elite years left and no one in this league will pay what he's worth to you.

top_targets.why_they_trade: League's top team, Win-Now, buying — Mahomes over Allen's injury risk is the only pitch that tempts them

4046.what_to_avoid: Any offer built around picks or prospects. You're a contender — trading Mahomes for futures resets your window.
4046.alternative: Hold. If Nix takes another leap, revisit in 2027 when Mahomes still has max value.

12517.sell_reasoning: Don't. A 22-year-old top-3 TE is a decade-long positional cheat code, even in non-TEP. You just traded Sadiq because Loveland has this position locked.

top_targets.why_they_trade: TE is their flagged hole and Loveland fixes it for a decade

12517.what_to_avoid: Even-value WR swaps. You're deep at WR; you can't replace an elite 22-year-old TE.
12517.alternative: Hold and enjoy the weekly edge at the league's thinnest position.

11563.sell_reasoning: Hold unless overpaid. Nix at 26 is your bridge to the post-Mahomes era and superflex QB2s of this quality rarely hit the market.

top_targets.why_they_trade: QB is their flagged hole, they're rebuilding, and Nix at 26 fits their timeline perfectly
top_targets.verdict: Ask — that's the overpay it takes

top_targets.why_they_trade: Weakest QB room in the league and openly rebuilding — Nix is the kind of piece they should overpay for

11563.what_to_avoid: One-for-one deals at market value. Selling Nix without an overpay makes you a one-QB team in superflex.
11563.alternative: Hold. His value climbs every week he plays like a starter.

12545.sell_reasoning: Your #1 sell. You carry 3 QBs behind a locked Mahomes/Nix pair — Shough never sees your lineup, and QB3s in superflex fetch real players from QB-desperate teams. Two of those exist.

top_targets.why_they_trade: QB is their flagged hole (Dart + nothing). Odunze is buried behind Wilson/Hall in their pecking order
League's worst QB room, rebuilding, WR surplus — Shough is exactly what they need
Same QB need; Hall is their RB3 behind Bijan

12545.what_to_avoid: Selling for picks — you want a young starter back, not futures. And don't wait: his value is a projection that camp reports can erase.
12545.alternative: If no one bites now, hold — a Week 1-2 starting-QB injury elsewhere turns Shough into a hot commodity.

7588.sell_reasoning: Declining at 26 with the name value of a younger back — classic sell-before-the-cliff. Your rookie RBs (Claiborne, Randall) plus Harvey cover the depth.

top_targets.why_they_trade: RB is their flagged hole; Egbuka sits behind Tate/Tyson in a crowded young WR room
Flagged RB hole and a WR surplus to deal from
Flagged RB hole with QB surplus — but you don't need Ward; ask for a pick instead

7588.what_to_avoid: Holding into the season. One bad month and 'Declining at 26' becomes 'done at 26' — this asset melts.
7588.alternative: Start him while shopping — production props up the price.

3198.sell_reasoning: Derrick Henry is 32. He's still a name, still producing, and that is exactly the moment to sell — the value only goes one direction from here.

top_targets.why_they_trade: Win-Now and buying; Henry is a title-push RB and MHJ is their WR5 behind Jefferson/London
The league leader going all-in; aging WR for aging RB swap that helps both title pushes

3198.what_to_avoid: Rebuilders — no rebuilding team wants a 32-year-old, so don't waste the conversation. Win-now teams only.
3198.alternative: He's your RB1 until the deal lands — keep starting him, keep shopping.

8167.sell_reasoning: WR is your deepest position (flagged surplus) and Watson is the depth piece with the most name value. Sellable, not urgent.

top_targets.target_owner: You Hate Us Cuz You Anus
top_targets.why_they_trade: Balanced team that could use WR depth; Jacobs is their RB3

8167.what_to_avoid: Selling him alone for less than 2000 — as a package sweetener he's worth more than as a solo deal.
8167.alternative: Best use: the second piece in a bigger trade (see Henry/Javonte packages).

7594.sell_reasoning: Declining at 27 and fourth in your RB pecking order once the rookies settle. Move him to an RB-needy team while he still projects starter touches.

top_targets.why_they_trade: Flagged RB hole, WR surplus, rebuilding — Hubbard gives them a real starter now
Flagged RB hole and they're selling vets — Jamo for a starting RB works for both
top_targets.verdict: Fair — but don't give Horton unless you love Jamo

7594.what_to_avoid: Packaging him with young pieces you'd rather keep (Horton, Bech). He's the asset being moved, not the sweetener.
7594.alternative: Hold as injury insurance until the rookie RBs prove out, then cut bait.

4035.sell_reasoning: A 30-year-old Declining RB on a contender's bench is a roster spot, not an asset. Any return beats holding him to zero.

top_targets.why_they_trade: Balanced team where Kamara upgrades their RB depth behind McCaffrey

4035.what_to_avoid: Waiting. Every week of age costs value; a 3rd today beats a 4th in October.
4035.alternative: If no takers, he's a fine bye-week starter until the rookies pass him — then he's a drop candidate.

5844.sell_reasoning: You start one TE and Loveland owns that slot for a decade. Hockenson is a proven starter wasting away as your TE2 — and three teams have a flagged TE hole.

top_targets.target_owner: You Hate Us Cuz You Anus

Flagged TE hole on a balanced team; Saquon is 29 and they're not clearly contending
Flagged TE hole — but they're rebuilding, so picks are the realistic return from them

5844.what_to_avoid: Selling him and Helm in the same window — keep one insurance TE behind Loveland.
5844.alternative: His value rises if he opens the season healthy — an early-season TE injury elsewhere is your best exit.

7525.sell_reasoning: Core starter — only move him in a consolidation trade that returns a clear upgrade. WR surplus means the depth sells first, not Smith.

top_targets.why_they_trade: All-in team that would take Smith's reliability; Brown is their RB3 behind Gibbs

7525.what_to_avoid: Selling into his age-27 season at a discount — he's productive NOW and you're contending NOW.
7525.alternative: Hold. He's a top-2 piece of the WR core that wins you 2026.

6801.sell_reasoning: Same tier as Smith: core starter, hold — unless it lands the young RB this roster still lacks at the top.

6801.what_to_avoid: Any deal returning picks or dart throws — Higgins only moves for a young starter.
6801.alternative: Hold and start him — Smith/Higgins/Watson is a weekly mismatch.

9487.sell_reasoning: 24 and Prime with WR5 usage on your roster — more valuable to a thinner team than to you, but no rush.

top_targets.why_they_trade: Rebuilder who values young WRs; you value the pick more than your WR5

9487.what_to_avoid: Selling low as a solo piece — he's a package elevator, not a headliner.
9487.alternative: Hold. Young WR depth is what keeps the contention window open past 2027.

12502.alternative: Hold on taxi. Costs nothing, and TE2s break out late.

12483.what_to_avoid: Using him as a trade sweetener — Boutte is the sweetener; Bech is a lottery ticket with better odds.

12497.sell_reasoning: Same profile as Bech — 23, Rising, cheap. Hold unless a deal you love needs a young piece to close.
12497.what_to_avoid: Giving him up as filler in vet-for-vet deals.

13347.sell_reasoning: Your 3.09 from two weeks ago and part of the answer to the aging RB room. Not for sale.
13347.what_to_avoid: Any deal — you drafted him to be the post-Henry depth chart.
13347.alternative: Hold. Camp reports will move his value more than any trade.

9504.sell_reasoning: Your designated sweetener — a real NFL WR with just enough value to balance a package, and WR10 on your own depth chart.

top_targets.why_they_trade: He closes value gaps in the Shough/Henry/Hockenson deals listed on those players

9504.what_to_avoid: Cutting him — sub-1000 players with NFL roles are how you win trade margins.
